name: Modern city
description: A modern street from the Cyberpunk and Sci-fi pack: road and pavement tiles, concrete and brick, street lamps, bins, signs, litter, street trees. It has one ordinary car, a yellow taxi (about 1.3×2.6 tiles): a vehicle feature becomes that taxi, and no bus, van or truck exists; ask for fewer, well-parked cars rather than many kinds.
